analysis: Both changed files are test-only. LaunchAgentRestartTests.swift (head lines 181-199) adds a test that DeadlineAdmissionFixes.environmentKey is in LaunchAgent.inferencePassthroughEnvKeys, is not in WatchdogAgent.passthroughEnvKeys, and that other variables such as UNRELATED_SECRET are still excluded from the plist. The allowlist behavior and the secret exclusion are pinned, not loosened, so this does not affect A-008 or other provider secrets. ServingQualificationDeadlineEvidence.swift (head lines 6-10) changes only a doc comment, with no logic change. The production changes (the DeadlineAdmissionFixes type and the passthrough key list in LaunchAgent) are not in the supplied evidence. That includes the new decodeRateShape behavior and whether the rollback env var can weaken admission or deadline controls. Admission is availability or QoS logic, not an authorization or encryption boundary. The threat model contains no admission-estimator assets, so I tied no threat IDs. Another pass should check, if those source files are in the PR: (1) that the new env key is parsed fail-safe, and that malformed values default to the secure on-by-default behavior; (2) that the passthrough list does not forward identity, token or attestation-related variables, consistent with TB-011 and T-053; (3) that the watchdog exclusion is real in the source. No security regression is identified from the supplied test and comment changes.
